mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_status_history (payment_id, from_status, to_status, reference, error_code, error_message) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reference}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_id, from_status, to_status, reference, error_code, error_message, created_at FROM payment_status_history WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
